method: Built-in image generation; identity preserved from supplied character reference sheet.

scenes.prompt:
Use case: compositing / identity-preserve. Asset: one vertical editorial photograph with the exact supplied stylized 3D male avatar composited convincingly into a REAL photographic setting. Image 1 is the photographic background EDIT TARGET: preserve its real architecture, adjacent facades, pavement, railings, street furniture, bollards and signs faithfully; do not turn the background into a cartoon or invent a new place. Image 2 is character reference only: exact same curly brown hair, brown eyes, shaped short beard, sunglasses on head, cream knitted polo, taupe loose trousers, brown/white sneakers. Same facial identity and proportions as the reference. Add just ONE avatar, natural human body scale to the scene, grounded feet and correct contact shadow and local light. Character should be recognizable but not filling the image: environmental candid photograph, not a character poster. Premium understated editorial photography with realistic surroundings, normal daylight, natural colors. No neon, no cyberpunk, no floating UI, no glowing code, no oversaturated colors, no new text overlays, no watermark, no backpack. Output ONE portrait-format image, around 3:4 framing, useful center composition for a portfolio photo card.

Camera a little below eye level, enough of the entry remains readable. Preserve exact real staircase and street layout. Crop the landscape reference to a suitable portrait composition without inventing architecture.

Preserve exactly the white SG sign with red/black emblem, pinkish stone steps, stainless steel railings and massive cylindrical metallic columns behind the glass, neighboring reflective facade on right. Create a single candid environmental editorial photo with this exact stylized 3D avatar seated in a REALISTIC photographic French apartment study corner. He is quietly studying systems and networking, slight forward lean, side three-quarter view looking down at a paper notebook, writing a short note with a pen. Plain wooden desk, just ONE laptop showing an understated network topology window, one plain closed technical book and a water glass. Authentic modest everyday environment, pale wall, daylight from a side window, normal imperfect lived-in desk, realistic textures and photography. No floating UI, no glowing code, no holograms, no dramatic hacker lighting, no motivational text, no giant logos, no studio posing. Character identity, cream knitted polo, brown curls, beard, glasses on head and plain taupe trousers must exactly match the reference sheet. He belongs to the room with consistent perspective and contact shadows. Portrait 3:4 framing with visible torso, desk and some room. One image, not a collage. This is a stylized avatar inside a photoreal environment, do not cartoonize the room.

Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE vertical 9:16 environmental editorial photograph for a portfolio card. Exact stylized 3D male avatar from reference: brown curly hair, short beard, big brown eyes, sunglasses on head, cream knitted collared polo sweater, plain taupe cargo trousers, brown-white sneakers, no backpack. Natural candid situation: working on a small systems-and-networking lab bench. He sits sideways at an ordinary desk, concentrating, one hand inserting a blue RJ45 Ethernet cable into a correctly sized REALISTIC 8-port metal switch on the desk. Other hand rests on desk, no extra fingers. One laptop next to switch, small cable coil, a compact mini PC, nothing else. Honest small lab or training workshop, real photographic plain walls, natural daylight, ordinary practical furniture, photoreal switches and cables with authentic scale. Not a giant datacenter, not server-rack cosplay, not a hacker movie. No neon green, no glowing UI, no holograms, no floating icons, no dramatic pose, no grinning at camera, no overdone saturation, no promotional text. Same character identity as reference, not a realistic human face, but all surroundings look photographed. Medium-wide 50mm composition showing practical manual work and cable connector. Avatar and his hands remain in central 55 percent of image width for responsive crop, full head visible.

Use the first image as the reference for a real Wavestone Tour Franklin meeting-room environment: saturated but natural blue back wall, wall-mounted display, white high table, high white stools, patterned glass partition to left, dark wood wall right, rectangular hanging light, white acoustic ceiling. Preserve this architecture and arrangement in a new candid vertical photo framing; do not copy the original seated woman. Replace her with the exact male 3D avatar from image2, now standing naturally at the table preparing a meeting: he plugs one real USB-C cable into a laptop while checking the wall display, focused three-quarter/profile view. A small black tabletop conference camera and a tabletop speakerphone near monitor are enough. A blank dark-blue presentation test screen on the wall display, not hacking code. Same curly hair, beard, sunglasses atop head, cream knitted polo and plain taupe trousers. No backpack. Understated work reportage, real light and realistic room/materials/equipment, the avatar alone is stylized 3D. No floating symbols, no extra labels, no heavy tech glow, no exaggerated smile, no staged superhero pose. Portrait9:16, mid-wide scene, keep avatar's face and cable connection inside central crop safe area. Output ONE image.
